title: Finite-cover filtered equalization for etale sections
statement: Given a finite family of etale arrows into an etale object, local eventual vanishing and the separatedness implication that vanishing on every member forces global vanishing imply eventual global vanishing in a filtered sheaf diagram.

proof.text: Choose one killing arrow for each member, use filteredness to equalize the finitely many arrows, and apply separatedness of the sheaf at the common stage.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_section_colimit_eventual_zero_of_finite_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ]
    (U : X.Etale) (I : Type w) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{max v w} Λ))
    (i : I) (s : (G.obj i).obj.obj (Opposite.op U))
    (K : Type w) [Finite K] (V : K → X.Etale) (q : ∀ k, V k ⟶ U)
    (hlocal : ∀ k, ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
      ((G.map f).hom.app (Opposite.op (V k))).hom
        (((G.obj i).obj.map (q k).op).hom s) = 0)
    (hsep : ∀ (j : I) (t : (G.obj j).obj.obj (Opposite.op U)),
      (∀ k, ((G.obj j).obj.map (q k).op).hom t = 0) → t = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), ((G.map f).hom.app (Opposite.op U)).hom s = 0
